nativeCircuitResult.samplingScope: One actual coherent preparation and gate replay; each independent shot samples every coherent factor jointly without collapsing the retained state. One seeded uniform draw per factor; correlations within a factor are preserved. Counters record only performed preparations, gates, factor traversals and sampled readout outcomes.

rows.stateSource: Selected coherent circuit premeasurement output; reduced single-qubit state.
rows.spinScope: X/Y/Z are reduced Pauli expectations from the actual retained coherent register, not the separately saved procedural model or a postmeasurement shot. Entanglement can give a mixed local state. An exact zero vector has no preferred direction; a nonzero vector below tolerance retains its components and is labelled near-maximally mixed.

coherentSpinPreview.scope: Actual reduced Pauli expectations for the first at most four qubits of the retained coherent circuit output before independent measurement shots. Each queried coherent factor has at most 65536 stored entries. Omitted qubits were not evaluated and are not assigned zero vectors. This capture is separate from the saved procedural model and from postmeasurement shot states.
coherentSpinPreview.verificationScope: These are actual circuit-state calculations. The procedural-model q.verify CPU/GPU sampling gate does not independently verify these circuit snapshots.

coherentOutputStatus.memoryAccountingScope: Dense tile bytes are exact; sparse dictionary storage is a conservative managed estimate. Process private bytes are measured for the complete host process (sampled at most every 250 ms; 3.0.3).
coherentOutputStatus.scope: Isolated preview: one selected register of up to 298 logical qubits; each coherent factor is limited to 59 qubits. Factor blocks preserve genuine entanglement. Global dense-state byte counts are mathematical bounds, not allocations. No physical quantum gates are claimed.

nativeCircuitResult.bitOrder: Most significant displayed bit at left; qubit 0 at right.
nativeCircuitResult.scope: Full joint bitstrings from independent Born-Z samples of the prepared coherent factors. Each factor is sampled jointly; its internal correlations are preserved. Histograms contain completed shots only; consumed draws and factor traversals from partial shots are counted separately.
